emerging_watch: Watching whether the Banks theme's breadth of 0.944 and high durability translate into a CONFIRMED leadership handoff — the condition that retires this watch is seeing Banks' score cross above Coal's for two consecutive detector prints while both remain eligible.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible theme with both a strong durability bar (0.82) and broad participation (breadth 0.944), suggesting a more cohesive trend than the top-ranked Coal. Coal wins the rank by a thin margin (0.037) but has a weak durability bar (0.5) and flat breadth. The crowding flag on Banks (z=1.83) is a size-down caution only, not a fade — the trend-gate eligibility and durability leg are the support here.
evidence: rank 2 with score 0.995, just 0.037 behind leader
theses.dissent: Banks is crowded (z=1.83, crowded=true) and the gate_helps=false verdict means even eligible trend themes mean-revert on this tape — the durability edge may not translate into forward return.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average and loses eligibility on the next detector print while CSI 300 is flat or up

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal tops the rank with score 1.032 and is flagging as the lone dominant one-narrative theme (one_narrative=true). That attention concentration plus a mean-revert hurst_tag and a weak durability bar (0.5) with mediocre breadth (0.5) reads as a late-stage leadership rather than an early trend. I lean underweight relative to the benchmark, not as a fade on crowding (it is NOT crowded), but as a durability caution when the only validated gate has no drawdown edge here.
evidence: durability_bar=0.5, breadth=0.5 (only half of constituents confirming)
theses.dissent: Coal is neither crowded nor extended and is the clearest single-theme leader; in a reflexively trending tape that concentration could continue longer than a mean-revert read suggests.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS makes a new 60-day high AND the durability_bar rises above 0.7 on the next detector print
